title: Lycurgus of Athens
summary: Raleigh names Lycurgus of Athens in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Lycurgus, a Citizen of Athens of a noble Familie, who with Megacles headed a faction in the time of Pisistratus. He is not Lycurgus who gaue Lawes to the Spartans, and not Lycurgus of Nemea. The one-word title would fold onto those records, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
